scope: Close the final asynchronous count-expiry admission gap; preserve successful Google proof, failed environment verification, independent reviews and risk history.
riskAnalysis: A proof valid at ledger dispatch may expire during the final awaited authorization read. Revalidate the retained private proof synchronously immediately before native fetch; do not retroactively expire an already transmitted request.

threatModel.assets: Dedicated project credentials, exact source/task/model/evidence identities, authorization lifecycle, token ceilings and retained spending.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Trusted parent native count response to private provenance proof; same existing CAS to one-use count/Responses admission; independently configured server pricing evidence to exact stored owner approval.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged/copied count, changed generation body, wrong model/project/context, expired proof, replay/concurrent dispatch, old approval pricing substitution, prompt-driven authority, uncertain provider failure or unpriced counting.
threatModel.mitigations: Fixed native endpoint and supported text-only projection including reasoning/schema; full request and count hashes, private WeakMap proof, 30second expiry, current-authority checks, one-use CAS, explicit12k/60k and4k/20k limits, reported usage parity, pinned zero-cost-only policy and retained ceilings. No price evidence exists, so live counting remains disabled.

rollback: Revert this prepared boundary only while all paid/count flags remain disabled and no new approval exists. Preserve immutable evidence and historical Google/Stripe/rehearsal records; never restore an old approval or enable the earlier byte-planned path.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Wrong object/fields, noninteger/oversized counts and secret echo fail closed before Responses dispatch.
negativePaths.stale-state: Source/context/request/expiry and authoritative stored approval mismatch deny dispatch.
negativePaths.concurrency: Count dispatch and count recording are one-use existing-CAS operations; duplicate winners cannot occur.
negativePaths.cancellation: Shared owner/task/revoke/lease checks run after counting and before dispatch; whole-operation abort includes count requests.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Bounded abortAdmission retains pending ceilings and reports cleanup uncertainty; no paid retry.
negativePaths.api-outage: Fixed endpoint/redirect:error, bounded response body, deadline and sanitized status/hash diagnostics; no fallback or retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Missing count consent/server pricing pin, impersonated roles or substituted workspace/source deny; no model-granted permissions.
negativePaths.spending-limit: At most five count attempts plus five Responses under existing stage ceilings; missing verified-zero-cost account pricing policy blocks native execution before admission. Unknown failures retain pending reservations.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Successful count alone cannot settle or accept work. Responses usage mismatch leaves pending evidence/reservation; no generated source execution or publication.

proactiveReview.architecture: Small extension of existing provider/transport/profile and journal, no duplicate gateway/controller/ledger.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Official Responses input-token count schema, fixed dedicated OpenAI project, existing task/source evidence and shared authorization CAS.
proactiveReview.threats: Pricing pin must match the authoritative stored approval, not a substituted caller argument; API content never grants authority.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Counting price/access/parity unverified, so live path disabled. Timeouts/revocation/uncertain cleanup preserve reservations rather than optimistic settlement.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Independent synthetic native fetch tests and actual profile tests cover count/proof/policy denial; one new realRedis concurrency/revocation case added for remote CI.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Root identified and Work Auditor confirmed final-await expiry race. Independent47/47 focused tests passed, including expired-beforeHTTP denial and in-flight expiry acceptance with real broker authority kept live. Final STRICT and hosted results remain required.
proactiveReview.recovery: Keep all flags/approvals disabled, retain historical accounting and evidence, preserve exact source checkpoint on interruption.
proactiveReview.readiness: Earlier local3224 suite had3203pass/21sandbox-environment failures, not acceptance. Final reviewed source needs correctly permitted STRICT. No native count/model call, new price policy, paid activation or Production change.
